svg.title: Choose between hybrid and top-clearance mode
svg.desc: Hybrid uses a frontier coding agent and local sensitive-content processing; permitted code and checked context can reach the frontier. Top clearance uses the approved local model as the coding agent, with no frontier calls, web tools, command networking or networked MCP servers. Local may be a workstation or self-hosted endpoint; it is not an air-gap guarantee.

g.text: Networked MCP servers are also unavailable.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 15.12px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Trebuchet MS', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #087f74

g.text: “Local” can mean your workstation or an approved self-hosted endpoint.

text.style: font-size: 13.68px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Trebuchet MS', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #536962

g.text: That endpoint and its network path remain part of your trusted environment.
